title: The Magic Login Mail or QR Code plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation via Administrator Account…
description: The Magic Login Mail or QR Code plugin for WordPress up to version 2.07 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows an attacker to take over an administrator account. This occurs because the plugin uses an unvalidated Host header to generate magic-login links, enabling interception and replay of authentication tokens. Exploitation requires the attacker to know the target administrator's email, the administrator to click a crafted link, and specific site conditions such as the shortcode rendering on a page where permalink retrieval fails.
